title: Temporary signs
previewText: Temporary signs relating to sales or events of limited duration not to exceed 45 days may be displayed in a show window of a building. Such signs must be removed after the last day of the sale or event to which they pertain. Temporary signs shall not occupy more than 20 percent of the surface area of the window in which they are displayed.
